text.title: Text
text.description: The text to convert to speech. Maximum 15,000 characters. Supports speech tags for expressive delivery: inline tags like [laugh], [pause], [sigh] and wrapping tags like text, text.

output_format.description: Output format configuration for the TTS API.
output_format.title: OutputFormat

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

language.title: Language
language.description: BCP-47 language code or 'auto' for automatic detection. Supported: en, zh, fr, de, hi, id, it, ja, ko, pt-BR, pt-PT, ru, es-MX, es-ES, tr, vi, bn, ar-EG, ar-SA, ar-AE.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Built-in xAI voice to use for synthesis.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
